source: OpenAI API pricing and OpenCode model catalog (models.dev)
notes: gpt-5.3-codex-spark rates are the published openai entry in the catalog OpenCode uses ($1.75 input, $14 output, $0.175 cached input per million tokens).
codex-auto-review has no published rate anywhere; it is marked internal so its tokens are excluded from the unpriced warning without inventing a price.
GPT-6 Sol and Luna use OpenAI's published Standard rates, including the full-request long-context tier above 272K input tokens.

GPT-6.1 Sol rates were verified against https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol on 2026-09-29: $2 input, $0.10 cached input, $2.50 cache writes, and $10 output per million tokens. Above 272K input tokens, input and cache rates double and output is 1.5x for the full request.
